method: Source-reviewed assertion requirements for every definition in the two dedicated Table suites. Requirements describe the complete test behavior; execution evidence separately determines remaining work. General shared helpers/types and fixtures are still dependencies.

tests.implementation_requirement: Support at least 1,000 annotated fields through count/write/read with the upstream five-second operation limits; avoid quadratic schema work.
Parse the many-column text fixture within the upstream five-second construction limit.
Join array-valued duplicate keys, filter the result to empty and collect safely without invalid memory access.
Resolve matching scalar/struct key expressions for Table and Matrix sources; return None for incompatible types. Mixed Matrix boundary.
Accept compatible tuple/struct key prefixes and reject incompatible leading types, across Table and Matrix sources.
Resolve point expressions against an interval key and reject type mismatches; includes Matrix row sources.
Resolve compatible leading point fields against interval keys, including Matrix compound row keys; reject mismatched prefixes.
Import/write/read 256-3,072-column Tables, add a field and collect rows into globals; preserve the upstream strict xfail mark on width 3,072.
Lookup by the first field of a compound left key, preserve the two left partitions and annotate every row correctly.
Single-match indexing preserves left duplicate multiplicity/order, matches seven rows in this fixture and handles an empty right Table.
Persist/reopen variable-length ndarray row values and compare them structurally.
Group consecutive rows into bounded arrays without crossing logical partitions, including partial final groups, prior filters and custom output names.
Retain partition-local grouping semantics after row multiplication by explode.
Group and collect VCF-derived genomic rows without storage lifetime failures; fixture requires Matrix/VCF conversion.
Index a shorter range from a longer one; propagate nullable right-side fields without incorrect requiredness assumptions.
Persist/reopen the complete all-values fixture, including nested and genomic types, globals and missing values.
Expose typed row streams per partition and flatmap them to multiple rows while preserving the key and local sequence.
Require a stream<struct> return and preserved key fields, raising the specified TypeError/ValueError.
Apply stream materialization after an indexed interval read and unkeying; return exactly rows 11 through 54.
Evaluate exclusive scan.collect in the then-current key order; later rekeying must preserve the earlier scan results.
Persist an embedded/lowered plan and correctly evaluate both full count and a later filter.
Sort a lowered plan on a computed descending key and let agg.take consume that order.
Repartition a persisted range into ten logical partitions at read time using key-boundary planning.
Do not split a single all-missing key into ten requested partitions; one distinct key produces one logical partition.
Finalize counter aggregation on a fully filtered persisted input as an empty dictionary.
Multiple disjoint query intervals in the same source partition count as one retained partition; intervals spanning three source partitions retain three.
Support partition-stream grouped/flatmap/map composition after annotation on VCF-derived genomic rows.
Apply head/tail and count/_force_count across range, parallelize, cache and checkpoint inputs, 3/11 requested partitions and all boundary sizes; 160 combinations.
Export nullable int/string dtypes and nested Struct objects with flatten=False.
Apply a Hail-type-to-pandas-dtype override recursively to flattened fields while retaining string/object defaults.
Apply a column-name dtype override only to the specified flattened column.
Flatten nested structs into dotted pandas columns while leaving arrays as object values.
Preserve missing values with pandas nullable Int32/Int64/Float32/Float64/boolean/string dtypes.
Export ndarray values as NumPy arrays in pandas object columns.
Infer and evaluate literal arrays of NumPy int64 values returned through pandas conversion.
Infer and evaluate literal arrays of NumPy int32 values returned through pandas conversion.
Infer missing pandas NA alongside NumPy int64 elements without losing integer type.
Infer missing pandas NA alongside NumPy int32 elements without losing integer type.
Write one keyed child Table per selected field and reopen each with exactly the key plus that field.
Use persisted index boundaries correctly across five branching factors, removed boundary rows and inclusive/exclusive endpoint combinations; return 141-144 and 152.

Execute a 10,000-row computed descending sort across ten source partitions without changing count.
Validate point/interval key types, reject empty struct queries and reject too many key fields with the specified ValueError messages.
Return an evaluable ordered array from persisted point or interval queries, handling absent/out-of-range points, scalar/struct endpoints and inclusivity.
Assign distinct random row identities when concatenating results from two persisted interval queries before array aggregation.
Support scalar/struct prefix queries and lexicographic full-compound-key interval bounds.
Distinguish exact interval-valued key lookup from an interval over interval-valued keys, including reversed/empty queries.
Collect a 1,500-row range represented by 1,500 logical partitions within the upstream timeout.
Produce a lazy int32 range up to 2^31-1 rows and aggregate its cast int64 sum without eager whole-range allocation or overflow.
Reject grouped aggregation output fields that collide with existing globals using ExpressionException.
Evaluate arithmetic/comparison/boolean expressions and nested array map, flatmap, slice, filter and reductions; infer set literals and propagate missing nested values; preserve no-op annotation.
Implement sum/count/collect, filtered aggregators and explode-mean over row arrays, with structured aggregate results.
Implement grouped min/max/sum/product/count/count_where/fraction/stats/take-by, nested collection and missing explode; genomic Call, Hardy-Weinberg, inbreeding and call_stats kernels.
Evaluate globals both inside and outside filtered sum aggregators; aggregate constants and typed missing values without an aggregator.
Cast integers to strings, split into arrays, persist and force-read array<string> without encoding corruption.
Matrix/Table roundtrip with row, column and entry annotations; reconstruct and reorder columns. Explicit Matrix interoperability test.
Convert scalar or struct-valued Table columns into Matrix entries and back; reject mixed types, naming conflicts and empty entry-field lists.
Keep references to the input row alive when a computed group key shadows its name; collect_as_set and all over grouped results.
Aggregate counts correctly for interleaved and contiguous keys with a small aggregation buffer, across ten partitions.
Group duplicate string keys across partitions and compute floating-point means with exact output schema.
Treat missing keys as an aggregation group and preserve missing-last order in both shuffled and persisted sorted aggregation.
Evaluate row predicates, boolean conjunction/disjunction and literal True while preserving matching rows.
A missing boolean predicate removes the row.
Remove referenced top-level fields after computing an expression through a nested struct; preserve other fields and propagate missingness.
Compute a global expression and remove consumed global fields while preserving remaining field order/types.
Transmute retains consumed key fields while keyed; the same consumed field disappears after unkeying.
Support field expressions, named computed projections, struct expansion and zero-field rows; retain keys first and preserve schema order.
Reject attribute assignment to a Table with NotImplementedError; fixture additionally requires Call and explicit schema construction.
Compute exclusive scan.count before filtering and carry the prefix across ten partitions; the surviving final row has prefix 9.
Compute exclusive scan.count before tail and preserve original prefixes 70 through 99 across partitions.
Implement semi/anti joins using compatible key prefixes; reject longer right keys and keyless right tables with matching errors.
Resolve four nested Table index expressions and materialize their dependencies in aggregation scope.
Support Table/Matrix row indexing and Table lookup from Matrix column expressions; requires VCF and Matrix interoperability.
Return a typed, evaluable global struct from index_globals.
Index an interval-keyed Table by point/struct key with endpoint semantics and missing results for unmatched rows.
Normalize unordered interval lists and compose interval filters correctly without duplicating rows.
Return all overlapping interval matches, with array mapping/sorting and correct overlapping-boundary behavior.
Persist a compound interval key, shorten it to the interval prefix, and return all matching rows with original values.
Build a valid index expression against a zero-row keyed right Table; unmatched values are missing.
Index with the left key struct and evaluate all over the resulting annotated field.
Support duplicate right keys and all_matches=True, retaining each right match and its expected order.
Repeated Matrix entry indexing in select_entries; this assertion exercises Matrix APIs and is outside Table-only execution.
Zip keyed inputs into arrays of optional row structs, retaining input positions, missing members and outer key union; avoid field collisions and preserve count after projection.
Collect each input's globals in input order, including missing global values.
Zip Tables keyed by a shortened genomic locus prefix; fixture requires VCF/Matrix rows and reference-aware loci.
Count the union of two shortened locus-keyed VCF Tables without losing or duplicating shared loci.
Write a multi-way zip join of highly skewed 100-versus-1-partition genomic inputs without a partition-boundary failure.
Ordinary Table indexing chooses at most one right match per left row even when right keys have duplicates.
Reject indexing a keyless Table with ExpressionException and the empty-key diagnostic.
Emit one row per group even when aggregate has no value expressions.
Drop row fields by name or field reference, support no-op and zero-field projections, and maintain key restrictions and metadata.
Accept whitespace, punctuation, dollar signs, backticks and Unicode field names across row/global projection, explode, drop and grouping.
Implement Hail-compatible seeded Bernoulli sampling; seed 0 and probability .25 retain exactly four of these sixteen rows.
Convert a Spark DataFrame's values and schema into a Table; explicit Spark interoperability boundary.
Import pandas columns with Hail-compatible inferred types and key ordering; compare to typed struct-expression construction.
Infer nested arrays, dictionaries and NumPy ndarrays from pandas object columns and preserve their values.
Convert nullable pandas integers/strings to missing values while preserving floating NaN as NaN, distinct from missing.
Reject a pandas object column mixing arrays and sets with ExpressionException and the type-inference diagnostic.
Infer nested dict/struct/array/tuple/ndarray, floating, Call and locus types from Python rows and expression values consistently.
Apply partial_type constraints while inferring remaining nested dictionaries, sets, arrays and structs.
Validate mutually exclusive schema and partial_type before parsing schema or other constructor options; raise ValueError with the expected message.
Rename row/global/key fields together, update expression source indices, and reject collisions, duplicate destinations and unknown fields.
Keep one row per key across partitions; collect_by_key yields one value and agrees with the distinct-key count.
Collect every value per duplicate key; explode/transmute must reconstruct the original multiset of rows.
Safely select a string from an array and retain its storage lifetime through forced execution.
Expose ordered int32 idx rows, idx key, empty row-value/global schemas and requested logical partitions.
Construct an empty range with typed idx; forced count and field collect return zero and an empty list.
Aggregate arrays elementwise with array_sum and apply elementwise array division to the aggregate result.
Reject exploding a key field even when its type is an array.
Explode a set into rows, preserving the other fields and producing each distinct set element once.
Explode a nested array field, dropping missing parent/array rows and replacing the nested field with each element.
Reject the name argument when exploding a nested field, with ValueError.
Export ordered fields with a tab-separated header, values and final newline through the filesystem API.
Honor a custom export delimiter while preserving header and row field order.
Write ordered shard manifests for separate_header and header_per_shard modes; import the manifest's shards without losing order or headers.
Stage native Table output locally, commit it and reopen an equivalent Table through the Python API.
Checkpoint, read and rewrite a fully filtered empty Table with correct schema and empty snapshot handling.
Honor min_partitions=50 during text import, including small input files.
Text-export/import every supported Hail value type, restore the key and compare values using absolute numeric tolerance.

Read adjacent [150,250) and [250,500) key intervals as two logical partitions, with exact counts, ordered rows and row UID support; recreate the equivalent fixture in the new format; legacy decoding is deferred.

Filter existing source partitions by adjacent half-open key intervals, retaining three intersecting partitions and exact rows; recreate the equivalent fixture in the new format; legacy decoding is deferred.

Read adjacent (150,250] and (250,500] intervals as two logical partitions with exact endpoint/count behavior and row UIDs; recreate the equivalent fixture in the new format; legacy decoding is deferred.

Filter existing source partitions by adjacent left-open/right-closed intervals and retain the three intersecting partitions; recreate the equivalent fixture in the new format; legacy decoding is deferred.
Resolve order_by field names containing spaces without expression-parser ambiguity.
Evaluate a computed negative key and take rows in its ascending key order across source partitions.
Select or exclude partition IDs/ranges, update partition counts, preserve each selected partition's rows and reconstruct the input by union.
Convert Matrix entries to arrays of row structs and columns to globals, matching an explicitly constructed nested Table.
Outer self-join localized Matrix entries and match the equivalent nested Table's schema and rows.
Union keyed ranges in key order; unkeyed union concatenates logical partitions and preserves their total count.
Handle a 100-input union with randomness preventing count folding; forced and ordinary counts both equal input count times multiplicity.
Handle a 200-input union without compiler recursion/stack failure; upstream marks this case xfail, which must remain visible.
Unify differing row schemas, widen numeric types, insert missing fields, preserve field order and keyed duplicate-row ordering asserted here.
Sort on a computed reverse field and ensure both field take and collect reflect the sorted sequence.
Sort ascending/descending by an array-element expression while preserving random expression values across repeated actions and take.
Implement all four join kinds with compound keys: missing key components do not match; preserve unmatched rows and the asserted missing-last output ordering.
Apply nonmatching missing-prefix semantics with varying second key components; retain all unmatched null rows without over-constraining their unspecified outer-join tie order.
Implement left/right/inner/outer joins when only the right side has missing keys; preserve the exact nonmissing and unmatched rows.
Compute/explode a keyed range into the left duplicate-key fixture with expected multiplicities 1, 2 and 3.
Compute/explode a keyed range into the right duplicate-key fixture with expected multiplicities 2, 3 and 4.
Left join multiplies duplicate-key matches (2x2 and 3x3) and retains the unmatched left row.
Right join multiplies duplicate-key matches and retains the four unmatched right rows.
Inner join emits each Cartesian product of duplicate-key groups, with counts 4 and 9.
Outer join combines duplicate-key Cartesian products and unmatched groups from both sides in key order.
Head/tail must preserve the same per-row random values as full collection; rewrites cannot reseed/reassign row identities.
Flatten a struct key into dotted row fields, remove the logical key as Hail does and preserve row values/order.
Expand genomic locus values to contig/position structs, remove the logical key as required and preserve values.
Expanding types preserves established row ordering even when logical key metadata changes.
Expand every supported Hail type in the all-values fixture without invalid schema or expression construction.
Mangle colliding row and global fields with deterministic suffixes while retaining the shared key.
Persist duplicate-key inputs, join and filter a key interval without dropping multiplicative matches; the selected key has four rows.
Preserve grouped-key cardinality when optimizing group_by/aggregate/count.
Permit fields named sample and _row through indexed field access without overwriting methods/internal state.
Resolve self-index joins together with literals and conditional whole-row/global structs without stale source references.
Return an aggregate expression from _localize=False and reuse it in native row annotation without Python materialization.
Return an evaluable array-of-row expression from collect(_localize=False), equivalent to local collection.
Return an evaluable truncated row-array expression from take(_localize=False).
Return an evaluable field-array expression from expression.collect(_localize=False).
Collect globals once and rows/keys/fields/computed expressions in established key order, with correct result shapes.
Support expression.take with both localized Python values and an evaluable array expression.
Render a typed empty Table after filtering without failure.
Render a zero-column Table while preserving its row count.
Implement _same over Table schemas, keys, globals and row values; identical ranges compare true.
Apply Hail's default numeric tolerance when comparing floating-point row values.
Return false for differing global schemas, row schemas or key metadata.
Return false for equal global types with different global values.
Return false for different row values or row counts.
Persist the full physical compound key and safely shorten it for subsequent prefix indexing.
Render very long column names without layout or execution failure.
Match exact show(handler=str) output, line wrapping, numeric formatting and nested array/set/dict/tuple rendering.
Apply line filtering and regex find/replace during text import, including Hail replacement capture syntax.
Treat any configured missing token as missing during headerless text import.
Sort string arrays using Hail-compatible Unicode comparison; e precedes accented e.
Write/read a shortened genomic key after VCF row conversion and allow key-only projection without physical-key corruption.
Coalesce and nonshuffling repartition an unkeyed Table while preserving rows.
Reopen a persisted ordered range using fifty logical partitions and preserve all 444 rows.
Detect output paths also used by the input plan and raise the expected FatalError before destructive overwrite.
Group on a boolean expression, combine sum/max with globals before and after aggregation, preserve result schema/globals, and reject aggregate fields that collide with the group key.
Resolve Table index expressions inside group keys and aggregate bodies, sharing their dependencies while preserving global scope and exact sum/max results.
Implement grouped agg.take with an ordering expression, returning the three smallest values in order.
